1266.body:
Adds a cumulative per-instance SVG rasterization counter (`WidgetRenderer::raster_count`) and `FrameTelemetry::widget_rasterized` (instances re-rasterized while preparing a frame). New test `widget_param_update_rasterizes_only_that_instance` loads the built-in gauge and progress-bar bundles as main-gauge/main-progress: first frame 1/1, publish to the gauge gives gauge +1 / progress +0, an idle frame gives +0 for both. docs/scope.md Widgets bullet now says 're-rasterizes only that widget's SVG' (frame still re-presented in full; no damage tracking).

Verified: fmt, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings, tze_hud_telemetry tests, compositor targeted test + lib widget filter (HEADLESS_FORCE_SOFTWARE=1). Not run: `just ci` (just not installed), tze_hud_runtime tests (segfault on host).

Tests: +1 ~0 -0

1296.body:
- compositor `widget_transition` (8 tests) now creates its device via `common::new_headless_serialized`. Other direct `Compositor::new_headless` users in compositor `tests/` are single-test binaries (`gpu_canary`, `widget_raster_count`): no guard needed, noted in the helper doc.
- runtime `pixel_helpers::make_scene_runtime` takes a process-wide mutex around `HeadlessRuntime::new` (the lib-test `HEADLESS_RUNTIME_MUTEX` is `pub(crate)`, unreachable from integration-test binaries; `HeadlessRuntime::new` itself does not lock).
- Not added: locks for `tests/integration`, `vertical_slice`, `present_ack` suites. They have no lock today and pass concurrently in CI on llvmpipe; the real hazard (hardware ICD) is addressed by the pin. Would need a production-code lock or ~40 call-site edits.
- justfile: `test-integration`, `token-footprint`, `production-boot`, `canonical-app-boot` export `VK_ICD_FILENAMES` via the existing `lvp` var when the ICD exists (no change otherwise). `just --dry-run` (rust-just 1.58 wheel) shows the pin in each. ci.yml untouched (runners have only llvmpipe).
- AGENTS.md / justfile header comments corrected.

Verified under llvmpipe: compositor --lib 663 passed, --test widget_transition 8 passed, runtime pixel_readback 39 passed.

Tests: +0 ~0 -0
